verdict.rationale: Supabase gives users several levers touching retention/deletion: configurable backup retention (7/14/30 days) and PITR (supabase-supp-backups-pitr), self-hosting for full data control/compliance needs (supabase-docs-3/29), CLI telemetry opt-out via `supabase telemetry disable` or DO_NOT_TRACK (supabase-supp-telemetry-optout), and RLS/storage access controls plus MCP tools like delete_branch/pause_project for programmatic project lifecycle control. However there is no documented end-user 'delete my data'/GDPR-style deletion workflow, no explicit retention-policy configuration for AI/MCP interaction logs, and no first-party account/data-deletion API in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit GDPR/data-deletion API or account-deletion flow, documented retention settings for AI/MCP query logs, independent confirmation these controls work as described.
